description: Starts NightMarquee's AI-look check of a public website and returns a job. Read the result with get_job, which asks you to come back in a few seconds. The result page is unlisted: it is not shown on the public board, and anyone with the link can read it. Set publish to true only when the user asks for a public result. A check of the same address from the last day is reused. Each account can run five checks an hour and twenty a day. Needs a connected account.

publish.description: List the result publicly. Leave it false unless the user asks for a public result.

url.description: The public website address to check, for example https://example.com.

name: check_site
title: Check a website
